item.text: The saved feedback ties the failed handoffs to medic and caster deaths. I’m separating their positions, reducing competing targets in the artillery attacker’s range, and assigning fresh operators to later damage windows. Shell access failed because of a sandbox setup error, so these remain unverified tactical hypotheses based on the supplied evidence.
